snippet.title: The Icarus Experiment Game Trailer | Adventure Game
snippet.description:
Plumb the depths of a doomed leviathan on a mission to save a dying solar system. Unravel a mystery that could alter the fate of humanity. Created with Adventure Forge, this showcases the power of the no-code tool that lets you craft your own narrative-rich experiences.

👉 Discord Community: https://bit.ly/af-discord-yt-tutorials
👉 Adventure Forge Closed Beta Signup: https://bit.ly/af-closed-beta-yt-tutorials
👉 Adventure Forge Documentation: https://bit.ly/AF-Docs

The Icarus Experiment is a narrative-driven, choice-based adventure game set aboard the UNE Hyperion, a spaceship that harbors deep secrets following a catastrophic experiment gone awry. In this tension-filled, sci-fi universe, players navigate through a series of puzzles, moral dilemmas, and hidden dangers, unraveling the mystery of what led to the ship's demise.

📖 Facebook: https://facebook.com/thegameforges
☁️ BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/adventureforge.games
